integrity: Proof uses a direct weighted shift reduction, elementary finite-frequency equidistribution, and a stated-and-proved monotone spectral counting lemma; finite checks support but do not prove the universal limit.
scientific_limitations: Only finite distinct-root nonzero-mode Ward recurrences on the classical normalized Gaussian Fock Hilbert space.
No claimed exact finite-rank singular values or second-order asymptotic.
An abstract earlier rearrangement theorem could imply the counting principle; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: A phase-independent singular-value Weyl law for Binet recurrence derivatives on Fock space
